hooks.name: Copy tone check
hooks.description: When src/core/copy.ts or any src/**/index.html is saved, check every user-facing string against the Copy rules in the design steering file and list violations.

action.prompt: src/core/copy.ts or an index.html under src/ was just saved. Read the saved file and the "Copy" section of .kiro/steering/design.md. Check every user-facing string in the saved file (button labels, headings, help lines, placeholders, titles, aria-labels, toasts, error messages, empty states; not code comments, ids or class names) against these rules: English only; plain and literal; no exclamation marks; no puns on death or RIP; no memes or emoji; never address the reader (no "you", "your", "we'll"); one line for empty states; the exact wording the steering file fixes (tagline, "Nothing has died here yet. Give it time.", "No grave bears that name.", "Clear search", the toasts, "≈ … freed (estimated)"). List each violation as: file, line, the string, the rule it breaks, and a suggested plain rewrite. If there are none, say "Copy check: no violations" with the number of strings checked. Do not edit the file; only report.
